Coming to connectivity and logistics, Adani Ports handled over 500 million tons of cargo for the year FY 2025-26, thereby setting a stunning benchmark for the nation.
Coming to financials, in FY 2025-26, your Group delivered a consolidated portfolio revenue of ` 2,91,742 crore, reflecting a growth of 7.4% year-on-year.
Growth & demand: At Adani Energy Solutions Limited, our transmission order book rose from ` 59,936 crore to ` 71,779 crore.
